title: Boxes vary highly in quality
text: I like the first box, but be cautious.  My son asked me to get this during the Corona boredom.  The first box I got, from Korea, had a variety of treats, including delicious chocolate and not so delicious (to us) seaweed.  It was not the best buy, (sizes were relatively small) but fun to have a variety of imported treats from an unknown country.  I enrolled in a subscription and the next 2 -- from Ireland & Japan and were absolutely terrible in taste and value both.  Part of the idea is that you will get an item or 2 that you really don't like or that you would never think of trying, but I did not expect to get only 1 item we actually like in a box.  I would suggest trying more than one box before deciding for yourself.
label: negative
